verified_facts.text: The one-bedroom oceanfront suites in Moana have a private wraparound balcony with views of the Kaanapali coastline, Black Rock's coral reef and the islands of Lanai and Molokai.

verified_facts.text: The Ohana Suite is the resort's family suite, with a pull-out bed and a Murphy bed to sleep up to 5 people.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ohana Suite is Sheraton Maui Resort & Spa's premier family suite, featuring either a king or double beds with both a pull-out bed and a Murphy bed to sleep up to 5 people.

verified_facts.text: A cliff dive ceremony takes place every evening at sunset, a tradition since the resort first opened.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sheraton Maui’s nightly cliff dive ceremony takes place every evening at sunset, and has been a tradition at our Maui resort since first opening in 1963.

verified_facts.text: The cliff dive honors Kahekili, the last chief of Maui, who leapt from Puu Kekaa's sacred promontory.
verified_facts.excerpt: A tradition since the resort first opened in 1963 that honors the last chief of Maui, Kahekili, who used to leap from Puu Kekaa’s sacred promontory to show his spiritual strength, uniting his warriors.

verified_facts.text: Guests can see tropical marine life, coral reefs and honu (green sea turtles) in the waters right in front of the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests at our hotel near Black Rock Beach in Maui can see tropical marine life, vibrant coral reefs and the beautiful honu (green sea turtle) in the waters right in front of the resort.

verified_facts.text: The lagoon-style pool has several large swimming areas linked by lava-rock waterways, a small waterslide and a shallow children's area.
